key_points: $41B debt financing announced triggered ~10% share drop on leverage concerns.
Potential state lawsuits may block Warner Bros. merger, adding regulatory overhang.
Court-approved settlement with state AGs removes one legal hurdle for the deal.
High-grade bond offering to fund takeover exceeds $109B, showing financing ability but raising debt levels.
Scheduled stock split on Oct 5 may boost liquidity but is fundamentally neutral.
